subject: 三层西方阿弥陀佛
prompt:
Create ONE high-resolution photorealistic reference-guided reconstruction of the SINGLE specific Yingxian Wooden Pagoda sculpture in the attached reference, not a generic Buddhist statue. Portrait 1024x1536. Strict centered straight frontal near-orthographic camera at sculpture mid-height, symmetrical framing, FULL requested figure and attached base with 5% margin, no cropping. Neutral light-gray seamless studio backdrop, soft even diffuse illumination, sharp face and exact fingers, all in focus. Preserve the exact sculpted facial proportions, eyes, smile, body pose, garment folds, headdress, number of arms, hand positions and visible iconographic details of this specific reference. Material is realistic handmade ancient painted clay sculpture, mineral pigments and gilding, NEVER living human skin, wax, glossy plastic or cartoon/CGI. Clear shape separation suitable for 3D modeling. Isolate from temple, other figures, columns, halos not actually present, offerings and photographic clutter. No captions, lettering, watermark, panels or collage. Image is an AI interpretation, not documentary evidence; metadata outside image will say this. Subject-specific visual observations: Seated crosslegged round-faced Buddha with dark blue curled hair. BOTH hands overlap and cup together at center lap in meditation gesture, thumbs meeting; no raised hand. Gilding remnants face/chest, gray cream flowing robe. Include broad lotus band with petals and polygonal layered compact base, small photographed bird-like recessed supports only; no invented detailed animals. Remove bowl, water bottle and all offerings.
HYPOTHETICAL PRE-WEATHERING appearance: depict this exact sculpture freshly completed, before deterioration. Repair only damage, keep all original geometry. Continuous CLEAN paint surfaces, intact gilding where evidenced, NO weathering, NO dirt speckles, NO dark stains, NO chips, NO cracks, NO peeling, NO patina. Existing pale exposed ground patches on face/chest that clearly interrupt gilding should become continuous subdued gold. Preserve subtle handmade clay grain and brush texture, not distressed texture. Conservatively reconstruct only colors evidenced by surviving pigment; no arbitrary elaborate patterns, ornaments, fantasy jewels or newly invented objects. This is plausible pre-weathering appearance, not a claim of verified original Liao paint.
local_processing: 仅添加 PNG AI 生成文字元数据；图像像素未改变
scope: 全身、莲座与照片可见基座
identity_status: 沿用项目与选图称谓；视觉对应不等于独立宗教身份鉴定
limitations: AI 生成的建模参考，不是实拍；正面角度与遮挡细节含推测。
复原版依据现存形制和残留色彩推测，不代表已证实的辽代初建原貌。
面部、手指、纹样和座下支承仍需实物或高清照片复核。
review: 已逐图目视核对构图、主要手位、臂数、头饰和座式；保留生成解释误差，不作为测绘。
